description: BodyBio makes science-backed cellular-health supplements - phospholipids, balanced fatty acids and gut and nervous-system formulas - sold direct to consumers, with a 25-plus-year practitioner-trusted history.

evidence.summary: BodyBio's own affiliate page runs two tracks. The Creator/Influencer Affiliate track - the consumer creator route recorded here - pays 20% commission with a 15% audience discount code that applies to all products including first-time subscription orders and is valid for first-time and returning customers; the program is managed through Superfiliate. A separate Practitioner Affiliate track (15%, private clients only, strictly prohibited from being shared on online platforms) is not the route recorded here.

Third-party figures conflict with the brand's own page - Lasso lists BodyBio at 3% to 10% per sale and Shopper lists 5-10% - against the 20% creator-track rate published on BodyBio's own current affiliate page; the brand's own page governs and the dissent is documented here.

reasons.compensation: A published 20% commission on the brand's own page, valid on subscriptions and returning customers; no cap statement is published, so the cap stays unknown.
reasons.contact_access: Application runs through the brand's own affiliate page into Superfiliate; no direct affiliate email is published.
reasons.credibility: A 25-plus-year science-backed supplement company with a strong practitioner reputation.
reasons.niche_fit: Cellular-health and functional-medicine supplements sit squarely in the health and wellness content niche.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open application from the brand's affiliate page, with no follower minimum stated for the creator track.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A dedicated Creator/Influencer track with an audience discount code and a managed Superfiliate portal shows a real creator channel, separate from its practitioner track.

description: Javvy Coffee sells coffee concentrate and protein coffee products direct to consumers, built around fast iced-coffee and protein-drink routines.

Third-party figures conflict with the brand's own page - Lasso lists up to 15% and FindAffiliates lists 5% - so the 10% published on Javvy's own ambassador page governs and the dissent is documented here.

description: PLANT OF LIFE is a Canadian CBD brand selling hemp-derived CBD oils, drinks and pet products direct to consumers, with third-party lab reports attached to every product batch.

evidence.summary: PLANT OF LIFE's own affiliate page offers 10% of every referred order with a 60-day referral cookie; applications are reviewed by hand, usually within 2 business days, commissions are confirmed 30 days after the order and paid by Interac e-Transfer on the 15th of the month once the balance reaches $25, and the page names fitness, yoga, health and nutrition and lifestyle as collaborator niches.

The page states verbatim: 'No commitments, no initial investment, and no cap on how much you can earn.' - an explicit no-cap statement about earnings on the brand's own page, so the cap is verified uncapped.
